name: TRADFRI LED driver, 10 w (ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2)
config_flow_discovery_remarks: Select this profile only if the printed driver type is ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2. The shared Home Assistant identifier may also match IL-1. Select the driver revision and connected load you actually have.
config_flow_sub_profile_remarks: Select '4x YTBERG 1.5W' only for an ICPSHC24-10EU-IL-2 driver connected to four YTBERG 1.5W lamps. This profile estimates the complete assembly: the driver plus all four lamps. It does not apply to a single lamp or any other load. Do not divide the measured power by four.
